alt: Table of the five design groups with the rule that defines each, the states in it, the number of states, and ACS person records 2011–2019.
note: Dates are effective (coverage) dates, not adoption or approval dates.

rows.rule: ACA expansion effective 2014-01-01; no statewide expansion for low-income adults in 2010–2011 and no broad adult coverage before 2014
rows.states: AR, AZ, CO, HI, IA, IL, KY, MD, ND, NM, NV, OH, OR, RI, WV

rows.rule: No ACA expansion in effect by 2019-12-31 and no statewide change in adult eligibility during 2011–2019
rows.states: AL, FL, GA, ID, KS, MO, MS, NC, NE, OK, SC, SD, TN, TX, WY

rows.group: Set aside: January 2014 expanders with earlier coverage
rows.rule: Expanded 2014-01-01 but already covered low-income adults statewide (ACA early option or Section 1115 waiver, 2010–2011) or broadly (pre-ACA programs)
rows.states: CA, CT, DC, DE, MA, MN, NJ, NY, VT, WA

rows.rule: ACA expansion effective after 2014-01-01 and by 2019-12-31
rows.states: AK, IN, LA, ME, MI, MT, NH, PA, VA

rows.group: Set aside: other eligibility change in the window
rows.rule: No ACA expansion by 2019, but a statewide waiver changed adult eligibility during 2011–2019

source: KFF Status of State Medicaid Expansion Decisions; medicaid.gov; see _data/expansion_dates.csv for per-state sources
